result.summary: The pedestrian environment lacks basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps at a visible crossing point. Large parked vehicles significantly obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and motorists, creating a hazardous condition for those attempting to cross the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians are crossing at an intersection with no painted markings or signage to alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the pedestrian is walking

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trucks parked close to the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway where trucks are parked

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crossing to ensure clear visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a marked crosswalk and curb ramps, but lacks pedestrian signals or refuge islands. Parked vehicles near the intersection create visual obstructions, and the overall crossing distance is significant for an unsignalized location.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the crosswalk limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, along the curb near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with high-visibility crosswalks but lacks pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design with long crossing distances and large corner radii that may encourage higher turning speeds.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across multiple lanes without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the wide street.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radii
hazards.description: The corners are designed with large radii, which allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane one-way street with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a high-visibility crosswalk. However, the significant crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island or visible pedestrian signals increase exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane one-way configuration typically encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the risk of multi-threat crashes.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway spanning the width of the image

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian signals with countdown timers are installed and visible to provide clarity on crossing time.
